name: voice-clone-tts
description: Clone a voice from a short clip and speak with it, on your own machine. It needs the OmniVoice engine (torch, several GB), which Install engine on its card in Settings → Providers puts in this app's own Python environment; then download OmniVoice in Settings → Models. The engine runs in a process of its own, so a crash in it leaves the gateway up. A clone-kind voice profile routes here instead of being refused.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Compute Device
x-meta.help: Hardware acceleration for the diffusion cloning engine (mps on Apple silicon, cuda on NVIDIA).
